"""Fig 1: left = protocol schematic, right = reported vs fresh accuracy and the gap against n (real matrix).
Reads gap_vs_n (parquet/csv) with columns n, B_search, reported, fresh, gap, gap_lo, gap_hi, noise_floor, draws,
n_boot, pool, model, truth, arm, ci_kind, flag (see DATA_CONTRACT.md).
usage: python figures/src/fig1.py gap_vs_n.parquet OUT.pdf"""
import sys
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
sys.path.insert(0, __file__.rsplit("/", 1)[0])
import figstyle as fs
import fig1_schematic as sch

MARK = {5: "o", 20: "s", 100: "^"}


def main(src, out):
    d = pd.read_csv(src) if src.endswith(".csv") else pd.read_parquet(src)
    d = d[d["arm"] == "real"]
    assert (d["ci_kind"] == "pool-bootstrap").all(), "Fig 1 intervals must be pool-bootstrap"
    Bs = sorted(d["B_search"].unique()); Bmax = max(Bs)
    print("Fig 1 data:", d["pool"].iloc[0], d["model"].iloc[0], "truth =", d["truth"].iloc[0],
          "| n =", sorted(d["n"].unique()), "| B =", Bs, "| draws/cell =", int(d["draws"].min()), "| n_boot =", int(d["n_boot"].iloc[0]))
    fs.apply(); c = fs.C
    W, H = fs.VENUE["text_width_in"], fs.VENUE["max_height_in"]; pw = fs.VENUE["panel_width_in"]
    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(W, H))
    axs = fig.add_axes([0, 0, pw / W, 1]); sch.draw(axs)
    left = (pw + 0.55) / W; width = 1 - left - 0.01
    a1 = fig.add_axes([left, 0.56, width, 0.40]); a2 = fig.add_axes([left, 0.12, width, 0.34], sharex=a1)
    top = d[d["B_search"] == Bmax].sort_values("n")
    a1.plot(top["n"], top["reported"], "-o", color=c["reported"], ms=3.5, label="reported (on $S$)")
    a1.plot(top["n"], top["fresh"], "-s", color=c["fresh"], ms=3.5, label="fresh items")
    a1.fill_between(top["n"], top["reported"], top["fresh"], color=c["reported"], alpha=0.12, lw=0)
    a1.set_ylabel("accuracy"); a1.legend(frameon=False, loc="upper right", handlelength=1.4)
    plt.setp(a1.get_xticklabels(), visible=False)
    a2.axhline(0, color=c["ink"], lw=0.6)
    nf = d["noise_floor"].mean()
    a2.axhspan(-1.96 * nf, 1.96 * nf, color=c["noise"], alpha=0.25, lw=0)
    ls = {5: ":", 20: "--", 100: "-"}
    for B in Bs:
        g = d[d["B_search"] == B].sort_values("n")
        a2.fill_between(g["n"], g["gap_lo"], g["gap_hi"], color=c["reported"], alpha=0.15, lw=0)
        a2.plot(g["n"], g["gap"], ls[B] if B in ls else "-", marker=MARK.get(B, "o"), color=c["reported"], ms=3.5, label=f"$B$={B}")
    a2.set_xscale("log"); a2.set_xticks(sorted(d["n"].unique())); a2.set_xticklabels([str(x) for x in sorted(d["n"].unique())])
    a2.minorticks_off()
    a2.set_xlabel("search-set size $n$"); a2.set_ylabel("gap (reported $-$ fresh)")
    a2.legend(frameon=False, ncol=3, loc="upper right", handlelength=1.6, columnspacing=0.8)
    fig.savefig(out, bbox_inches=None, pad_inches=0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(*sys.argv[1:3])
EOF
